I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the hub replacement at Zoom Room B is IT ticket **#4092**.

Ilse posted that number in #north-random yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55) and said the ticket is still open. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I included that in the reply too. Everyone in #north-team is also in #north-random, so the reply doesn't share anything new with them.

I left out the guess Dana sent me in our direct message, since she asked me to keep it private.
